name: Xentral
what: Cloud ERP for small and mid-sized online merchants (orders, warehouse, purchasing, invoicing, accounting).
homonym_note: Same company as the sequoia-capital, lightspeed and 20vc rows (Xentral ERP Software GmbH, Augsburg).

membership.basis: Live visionaries.vc portfolio; TechCrunch and VC Magazin name Visionaries Club in the Series A; Robert Lacher joined the board.
membership.quote: with Visionaires Club (a B2B-focused VC out of Berlin) also participating

entry.quote: has picked up a Series A of $20 million

valuation.note: Wikipedia says 'By 2024, Xentral had been valued at around EUR 670 million', citing Business Insider Deutschland (2024-05-21); the underlying article was not fetched and it is not tied to a priced round, so it is not recorded as a valuation.

notes: VC Magazin (2021-01-19): 'Robert Lacher von Visionaries Club' joined the board with the Series A. TechCrunch spells the firm 'Visionaires Club'. Series B is August 2021 (TechCrunch 2021-08-17, Visionaries named as existing investor); the 20vc row's 'Series B of January 2022' date is wrong. Registers: Visionaries Club Growth Fund I lists Xentral ERP Software GmbH in 2023 (https://www.northdata.com/Visionaries%20Club%20Growth%20Fund%20I%20GmbH%20&%20Co%C2%B7%20KG,%20Berlin/Amtsgericht%20Charlottenburg%20(Berlin)%20HRA%2055965%20B); Visionaries Club Late Growth I (single-company SPV) is on Xentral's shareholder lists of 2021-11-09 and 2023-10-06 (https://www.northdata.com/Visionaries%20Club%20Late%20Growth%20I%20GmbH%20&%20Co%C2%B7%20KG,%20Berlin/Amtsgericht%20Charlottenburg%20(Berlin)%20HRA%2058572%20B), consistent with an SPV for the Series B. Founded 2018 as a startup per TechCrunch (Wikipedia dates the roots to 2008 in Augsburg). HQ Augsburg per the imprint (Viktoriastrasse 3b, HRB 23930).
